question.text: When an investor BORROWS at Rf and invests MORE than 100% in the market portfolio, her position is:

answer.text: To the LEFT of the market portfolio on the CML
To the RIGHT of the market portfolio on the CML (leveraged)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Borrowing at Rf + investing > 100% = leveraged position — to the right of M on the CML. Higher return, higher risk. **The Trap:** Without borrowing, positions are between Rf and M; borrowing extends rightward. **Cross-Exam Context:** CML extended. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Leveraged index funds (2x/3x NIFTY) are retail implementations — be cautious of compounding decay for long-term holds.
